label: V1d — yellow organic ribbon
prompt:
Make ONE very local colour edit to this exact supplied book cover: change the TOP-LEFT diagonal "100% Organic" ribbon from red to a warm clear harvest yellow, approximately #F2CC35. Change the ribbon lettering from white to the book's dark forest green, approximately #064D20, for good contrast on yellow. Preserve exactly the same ribbon size, diagonal angle, position, edge crop, subtle shadow, typeface and exact wording "100% Organic". The ribbon still lies visibly on top of the vegetable photograph.
Everything outside the ribbon must remain as close as possible to the supplied image: the photorealistic tomatoes, onion, peas, carrots and kale; continuous pale sage/ivory scrubbed-wood background; all title letters and sizes; no leaf logo near the title; exact subtitle and author; the existing white YouTube sticker at lower right; the black-and-gold Traditional Measurements sticker at bottom left, with its complete text and weight symbol. Do not recolour the red tomatoes or the red YouTube play logo. Do not change the gold measurement sticker. No extra items, new textures, lettering changes, arrangement shifts, added mottling or global colour adjustments. Full-bleed flat portrait front cover in the existing 185:240 proportions. Preserve original foreground sharpness and detail. Only the ribbon and its own lettering change colour.
decision: Warm yellow ribbon with dark-green type for contrast; black/gold measurement sticker retained.
